summary: Renders a debug overlay by filling a 64-byte local buffer with SeasonNameLookup, then drawing it with UITextRenderWithScale in white (0xFFFFFF) passes at x = a1, y = 10. The lap-count line (sub_49C670) is drawn at the same position, followed by DoubleRenderPass(a1, 50) for the mid overlay row, then two more format/render pairs at y = 90 (sub_49C700 and sub_49C770). Returns the result of the final UITextRenderWithScale call. Structural twin of MultiColorTextRender (004dbf90) per cluster prelabel.

operations.description: Call SeasonNameLookup(v2, 64) to fill the local 64-byte buffer with the season name.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1, 10, 0xFFFFFF, 1, 2, 1.0, 1.0) to render the season-name text in white at x = a1, y = 10.
Call sub_49C670(v2, 64) to format lap-count text into the buffer.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1, 10, 0xFFFFFF, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0) to render a second white pass of the lap-count row at the same position.
Call DoubleRenderPass(a1, 50) to render the paired mid overlay text at x = a1, y = 50.
Call sub_49C700(v2, 64) to format secondary text field 1 into the buffer.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1, 90, 0xFFFFFF, 1, 2, 1.0, 1.0) to render secondary text field 1 in white at y = 90.
Call sub_49C770(v2, 64) to format secondary text field 2 into the buffer.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1, 90, 0xFFFFFF, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0) to render the second white pass of secondary text field 2 and return its result.
